diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: For a positive-probability history h_t and chosen action a, the next-state/observation law is the belief mixture sum_s b_t(s)T(s′|s,a)O(o|s′); q(o|b,a) and posterior τ(b,a,o) induce a controlled Markov belief model and finite-horizon Bellman recursion over observations.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: POMDP belief update / controlled belief-state transition schematic
diagram_candidates.reason: The statement moves through hidden state, action, observation, posterior belief and the Bellman step; a schematic can make the conditioning and zero-probability branch explicit.
diagram_candidates.maps_relations_content_to_draw_or_check: Show current belief b over hidden states, action a, latent transition T, observation likelihood O, resulting joint (s′,o) mixture, marginal q(o|b,a), and posterior τ(b,a,o) only when q>0. Then show belief-state transition K and reward r̄ feeding the finite-horizon recursion. Check the placement of conditioning on action and omission of zero-probability observations.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: The algorithm initializes optimistic Q(s,a)=U(s,a), collects batches of m reward-plus-discounted-greedy-successor targets while learning is enabled, changes Q only when Q−B̄≥2ε₁, and uses the global last-update time t* to re-enable or disable pair learning.
diagram_candidates.reason: The update depends on coupled batch count, learning flag, batch-start time, and global last-update clock; a state diagram could help readers track the less-obvious failed-batch reactivation rule.
diagram_candidates.maps_relations_content_to_draw_or_check: Show per-pair states enabled/collecting, batch-complete, Q-update and reset, or disable; annotate threshold Q−B̄≥2ε₁, t*←t on success, b≤t* re-enables, and failed batch disables only when b>t*. Check that a disabled pair does not sample/update until re-enabled and that the batch resets in either outcome.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: On the confidence event, the true parameter lies in the roundwise ridge-confidence ellipsoids; optimism bounds each best-action versus selected-action gap, and the elliptical-potential determinant sum yields the stated high-probability pseudo-regret bound.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: Confidence ellipsoid and optimistic action geometry
diagram_candidates.reason: The proof combines confidence geometry, optimistic scores, and a cumulative determinant potential; a low-dimensional schematic could clarify this proof route and distinguish per-round optimism from the summed bound.
diagram_candidates.maps_relations_content_to_draw_or_check: Draw a parameter-space confidence ellipsoid around θ-hat with θ* inside, a finite action set, the maximizing UCB action A_t, and the true-mean maximizing action; label the one-step optimism inequality and gap bound. In a companion potential strip, show V_t growth and log(det V_n/det V_0) controlling summed leverage. Check that the illustration is schematic and that the theorem assumes per-round mean range at most 1.

No clipping or overlap defect was found. Other lane items have no TikZ diagram to validate.

diagram_items.check: The TikZ graph has s₀→z edges labeled a:0 and b:1 and a z self-loop c:0, matching the prose descriptions and state/action assignments.
The number line places y₂=−3/4 left of [0,1] and x₂=P_K(y₂)=0 at the left endpoint; labels and orientation agree with the text.
